title: SUBOFF Pressure Extrapolation Comparison (SDAA 26-28)
description: Tests wall-pressure extrapolation methods (none/linear/quadratic) for SUBOFF bare hull Re=1000

none.extrap_formula: p_wall = p1 (pressure at near-wall cell, current method)

analysis.friction_note: Cd_f is identical across all methods (0.038967) since only pressure integration was modified
analysis.linear_effect: Linear extrapolation has negligible effect on Cd_p (+0.9%), slightly increasing total drag error (5.6% -> 5.7%)
analysis.quadratic_effect: Quadratic extrapolation reduces Cd_p by 14.9% (0.005389 -> 0.004584), reducing total drag error from 5.6% to 3.7% (34% error reduction)
analysis.conclusion: Quadratic extrapolation (3*p1 - 3*p2 + p3) improves pressure drag accuracy for SUBOFF bare hull. Linear extrapolation does not help — the pressure profile near the wall is not well-approximated by a linear gradient from cell 1 to cell 2, but is better captured by the quadratic fit through cells 1, 2, 3.
